note: Live price lookup settings. ebayCategories: eBay US category ids used to narrow searches. parts: optional per-part overrides, e.g. {"bestbuy": {"sku": 6614151}} to pin an exact Best Buy SKU, {"bestbuy": {"query": "...", "exclude": ["..."]}}, {"ebay": {"query": "...", "categoryId": 27386}}, or false to skip a provider for that part. plausibleRange: live prices outside [low, high] times the estimate are treated as mismatched listings and ignored. Run `npm run map-bestbuy` to propose SKUs.
